anomalies.observed: The net /LED_3.3V_POWER_SW contains only the anodes of D4, D14, and D23; it has no connection to +3V3, a switched supply, a driver, or any other source.
anomalies.expected: A net named LED_3.3V_POWER_SW should be connected to a 3.3 V power source (or a switched 3.3 V source) so that the LEDs can light; the LED cathodes are tied to active-low signal nets, implying the anode side must be powered.
anomalies.impact: D4, D14, and D23 will remain dark; Ethernet/activity LED indication intended by the board will not work.

anomalies.observed: R28 is a pull-up from +3V3 to SCL0_GPIO45, but its schematic value is 10 and the SPICE deck models it as 10 ohms, while its own description/MPN/LCSC fields identify a 10k resistor.
anomalies.expected: I2C pull-ups on this board are normally 10k (e.g. R23, R29, R30), and a 10-ohm pull-up is not a valid I2C pull-up value.

evidence.quote: (comp (ref "R28") (value "10") ... (description " 100mW Thick Film Resistors 75V ±100ppm/℃ ±1% 10kΩ 0603 Chip Resistor - Surface Mount ROHS") ... (field (name "MPN") (value " 0603WAF1002T5E"))

anomalies.impact: SCL0 would be driven through an excessively strong 10-ohm pull-up, preventing normal I2C low states and potentially causing excessive current on the I2C0 bus.

anomalies.observed: Both GND1 and GND2 pins of the isolated CAN transceivers U10 and U11 are connected to the same GND net.
anomalies.expected: For isolated CAN buses, the logic-side ground (GND1) and bus-side ground (GND2) should be separate/isolated; the specification states the board implements two isolated CAN buses.

evidence.quote: two isolated CAN buses (`CAN0`, `CAN1`), each driven by its own MCP2515 SPI CAN controller (`U8`, `U9`) through an isolated CAN transceiver

anomalies.impact: The galvanic isolation between the CM4 logic side and the CAN bus side is defeated, so the CAN interfaces are not truly isolated as intended.

parsed.summary: The files contain at least two clear deviations: a floating 3.3 V LED power net leaving D4/D14/D23 unpowered, and R28 being modeled as a 10-ohm I2C pull-up instead of 10k. The isolated CAN transceiver grounds also appear tied together, which contradicts the intended isolated CAN buses.
